title: Descriptives Translator
summary: Reproduce an SPSS Descriptives table, skewness and kurtosis included, with describe(type = 2).
hints: `describe(survey[, c("age", "anxiety_pre", "anxiety_post")], type = 2)` matches SPSS's skewness and kurtosis.
SPSS's "Valid N (listwise)" counts people with none of the three missing: `sum(complete.cases(survey[, c("age", "anxiety_pre", "anxiety_post")]))`.
Pick single numbers out of `desc`: `desc["anxiety_post", "skew"]` and `desc["age", "kurtosis"]`.

dialog.label: Options
dialog.value: Mean, Std. deviation, Minimum, Maximum, Kurtosis, Skewness

spss.syntax:
DESCRIPTIVES VARIABLES=age anxiety_pre anxiety_post
  /STATISTICS=MEAN STDDEV MIN MAX KURTOSIS SKEWNESS.
